title: Glutes session file
description: A file in src/data/sessions/ is a JSON array of sessions. Validate one file against this schema.

id.description: Stable id referenced by plans. Never rename an id that a plan uses.

name.description: Shown on the day card, in uppercase.

type.description: ss, thr and vo2 count as hard days (orange). z2 is lime. rest is aqua.

duration_min.description: Nominal duration shown next to the name. Should be close to the sum of the blocks.

description.description: The prescription text shown when the day card is opened.

tss.description: Planned training stress; 0 for rest and strength.

avg_power.description: Target average watts, or null for rest/strength.

notes.description: Optional coaching notes. Not shown in the app.

blocks.description: Ordered workout steps. Empty for rest and strength (no chart, no ZWO export).

power.description: Watts. ZWO export divides by the current FTP.

label.description: Shown in the chart tooltip and as the ZWO text event.

kind.description: Only work blocks count toward Work time; work is orange on hard sessions.

repeat.description: How many times to repeat the inner blocks.
